name: Podio
one_liner: Podio is a work platform for organizing apps, items, and tasks, with a public API.
auth_notes: OAuth2 with server-side, client-side, username/password, and app authentication flows. Access tokens last 8 hours; refresh tokens last 28 days.
access_notes: API keys are created in account settings (API Keys tab). API is available on paid and free accounts within base rate limits. Higher limits need a paid API Add-on. Some operations need Podio Support approval.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve API keys and OAuth2 with a documented API and no extra charge within base limits. Some destructive operations need a trust-level increase from Podio support, and higher rate limits need a paid add-on.

identity.quote: The Podio API lets you integrate with other services and build tools and applications on top of Podio

auth.quote: The Podio API uses the OAuth2 protocol for authentication.

access.quote: The Podio API is available to use for both paid and free Podio accounts.

api_surface.quote: Our API is split up into different areas, that each contains a subset of methods grouped by functionality.

mcp.quote: The server is live at https://mcp.podio.com — just point your AI platform at it and log in with your Podio account.

buildability.quote: There is no extra charge for using the API as long as the usage is within these base rate limits.
